statement: South Korea's government announced a plan to invest $919 billion to build 8.4 gigawatts of data-center computing power by 2029, expanding to 18.4 gigawatts by 2035.
why: A sovereign programme of this size is a multi-year purchase commitment for AI accelerators, memory and data-center capacity, and sets a floor under non-hyperscaler demand.

impact.mechanism: State-funded gigawatt-scale buildout converts into orders for accelerators and HBM and into demand for power and colocation capacity to host them.

evidence.excerpt: invest $919 billion to build 8.4 gigawatts of data center computing power by 2029

confidence.basis: Single secondary write-up summarizing a paywalled newsletter; the underlying government announcement was not read directly.

dispersion: 8.4 GW by 2029 expanding to 18.4 GW by 2035.
